description: RP4 oriT: the origin of conjugative transfer of the IncP-alpha plasmid RP4 (210 bp).

references.authors: Ziegelin G, Pansegrau W, Strack B, Balzer D, Kröger M, Kruft V, Lanka E
references.title: Nucleotide sequence and organization of genes flanking the transfer origin of promiscuous plasmid RP4.

label: RP4 oriT
note: RP4 oriT: the origin of conjugative transfer of the IncP-alpha plasmid RP4 (210 bp). The bases are the region two deposited oriT windows agree on (X54459 4636-4845); the element's own ends are unverified, as no accessible source maps them. The catalog carried two overlapping windows of this locus, under the names 'oriT' (228 bp) and 'RP4 oriT' (257 bp, with 6 bases of a cloning junction); both names now belong to this part.

provenance.sequence_source: X54459 (RP4 transfer region, Ziegelin et al. 1991), complement(4636..4845), 100% over 210 bp; identical in the IncP-alpha plasmid sequence L27758, complement(51128..51337)
